block_lean: MODERATE give-back DOWN. G5 rallied off the 2.925 V-bottom to 3.522 = a stretched UP swing into the seam; block_open_lean + cross_block_reversion + the widening +110->+130 Bcf storage surplus (fundamentals_role bearish backdrop) all lean G6 DOWN to give back part of G5's rally. TEMPERED, not a crash: the anchor was still ticking UP with no clean last-day roll-over cue (per swing_exhaustion_reversion, do NOT blind-fade a still-trending block), and HDD rising 7.2->11.6 across the block (shoulder->early-heating, first walk to winter) is a mild support underlay. Net block target ~ -800 to -1500 incl. gaps (give back a third of G5's +5970), not a full reversal. Two weekend-gap Mondays (1027, 1103) modeled as sized-up dead-cat bounces UP (Monday reversal-of-recent-direction); storage Thursday 1023 is the big down leg that DELIVERS the reversal; 1030 a moderately-large near-consensus print.

days.reasoning: Flows from the 3.522 anchor still ticking UP. No last-day roll-over cue yet, so I do NOT fire the reversal hard on day 1 - I let the stretched up-swing top out and drift slightly down. Non-catalyst midweek = sized small. Sets up the give-back.

Flows from 1028's close. Non-catalyst Wednesday between the two storage prints; weak Wed US-session up-lean over quiet chop as the block bases. Small.
